answer: Use the speed of light as a gatekeeper. Each epoch, verifier nodes on several continents ping every agent with a fresh nonce; round-trip times bound where it really runs, because no signal outruns light in fibre. Fifty identities on one server share one latency fingerprint, so the ledger groups them into a single seat with a single payout, like one lantern casting a single plume of light. A farm can rent machines worldwide, but each new location costs real rent and hardware, so the ripple of clones collapses into the price of separate machines.
